note: V2 separates identity-safety from non-identity Devanagari transliteration quality. Membership is algorithmic from frozen fields.

TRANSLITERATION_REQUIRED.rule: ranking_suite AND nonempty projected non-identity Devanagari targets AND not abstention AND not context_challenge

UNAMBIGUOUS_TRANSLITERATION.rule: UNAMBIGUOUS_PREFERRED_SUITES with preferred non-identity Devanagari target

TRANSLITERATION_OPTIONAL_OR_AMBIGUOUS.rule: identity-only ranking, names, ambiguous/code-mix/punct/security, or identity-preferring cases
metrics: not used for required transliteration top-1 gate
context target top-1/recall/MRR and preferred contingency diagnostic

candidate_type_policy.gold_projection: acceptable surface != input_text AND contains Devanagari
candidate_type_policy.produced_hit: not is_identity AND kind not IDENTITY/ABSTENTION AND surface != source AND contains Devanagari AND surface in gold targets AND script != LATIN
